Wholesale Beetroot Powder for Food and Ingredient Manufacturers

Beetroot powder from Tradenest Naturals is a fine milled, single-ingredient powder bought by food, beverage, bakery, nutraceutical and seasoning manufacturers who want beetroot colour and flavour in a dry, easy-to-store form. The raw material is carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers in India, then dried, milled and sieved for consistent handling in production. Our regular buyers include importers, distributors, FMCG brands, private-label businesses and food processors that need steady bulk supply. As a beetroot powder supplier and exporter from India, Tradenest Naturals handles both standard orders and buyer-specific requirements. You can ask for beetroot powder 80 mesh, a different particle size, bulk packing, private-label packing or guidance on how the powder behaves in your application. Send us your quantity, destination, packaging format and target specification, and we will come back with a sample offer and quotation.

Product Overview

Beetroot powder is made by cleaning, trimming and slicing fresh beetroot, drying it under controlled conditions, then milling the dried material and sieving it to a uniform powder. The finished ingredient has the deep red to reddish-purple colour and the earthy, mildly sweet taste you expect from beetroot. It is simple to dose, blends well in dry mixes, and works in recipes where fresh beetroot is not practical. Because most of the water has been removed, the powder is efficient to store, ship and process. Mesh size, packaging, labelling and order volume can be adjusted to your needs within the agreed specification. Colour intensity and flavour in the finished product depend on your recipe and process conditions, so we suggest running application trials before commercial use.

Manufacturing and Processing

Tradenest Naturals follows controlled processing steps aimed at keeping the raw material true to type, clean and consistent from batch to batch. Beetroot is inspected and prepared before drying. The dried material is then milled and passed through sieves to reach the required particle size. Our standard grade is 80 mesh, and other mesh ranges can be discussed for beverage, bakery, seasoning or premix use.
  • Raw-material selection and incoming inspection
  • Cleaning and preparation of beetroot
  • Controlled drying to reduce moisture
  • Fine milling to the agreed particle size
  • Sieving for better uniformity
  • Batch packing with traceability information
We can also look at custom blends, private-label packing and application-specific development. Every requested specification is reviewed before production so that raw material, processing settings, packaging and paperwork line up with what you need.

Typical Technical Specifications

The standard commercial grade is fine milled beetroot powder at 80 mesh, with moisture of 8% or less and a shelf life of 12 to 24 months. The standard profile is beetroot only, with no added carriers, colours or preservatives. These values are the basis for commercial discussion and are confirmed in the agreed product specification. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost.
  • Product: Beetroot powder
  • Processing: Fine milled
  • Standard mesh: 80 mesh, with other sizes available on request
  • Moisture: ≤ 8%
  • Shelf life: 12 to 24 months
  • Appearance: Fine red to reddish-purple powder
  • Flavour: Earthy, mildly sweet and typical of beetroot
  • Additives: None added in the standard profile (no carriers, preservatives or synthetic colours)

Quality, Safety and Documentation

Our quality checks focus on raw-material inspection, moisture control, sieving, batch identification, packaging integrity and traceability. Production and packing follow documented food-safety practices in our FSSAI registered facility. Requirements differ between markets and end uses, so please share any specific limits or parameters your market expects before you confirm the order. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. Tradenest Naturals does not claim any certification or approval beyond what has been confirmed for the product and shipment. During the quotation stage you can ask for the product specification, batch details, packing details and export documentation. As an IEC registered exporter, we support the export paperwork, and we review labelling language, ingredient declaration and import requirements with you before dispatch.

Applications

Beetroot powder is a flexible ingredient for both dry and wet food systems. Buyers use it to add beetroot taste and a natural red-purple colour to finished products. It disperses into liquids, blends into dry premixes and can be added during dough, batter, filling or seasoning preparation.
  • Smoothies, juice blends and instant drink mixes
  • Bakery products, doughs, cakes, biscuits and bread mixes
  • Snack seasonings, savoury blends and instant foods
  • Soups, sauces, dips, gravies and ready-to-cook mixes
  • Confectionery, dessert mixes and ice cream
  • Plant-based foods and nutrition blends
  • Private-label retail packs and ingredient kits
The right dosage depends on the flavour and colour you want, your processing conditions and the overall recipe. Pilot trials are the best way to check dispersion, colour stability, taste and compatibility with other ingredients.

Buyer Value

  • A dry format that is easier to handle than fresh beetroot.
  • A shelf life of 12 to 24 months that helps with stock planning and international distribution.
  • Bulk supply that simplifies procurement and helps control production costs.
  • Consistent milling and sieving for more even blending and dosing.
  • Flexible packaging and private-label options for different sales channels.
  • Export documentation support and worldwide shipping from India.

Packaging and Shelf Life

Packaging is chosen according to quantity, market, transport conditions and your requirements. Standard options include food-grade moisture-resistant inner liners, stand-up pouches, PET jars, HDPE containers and export bulk bags or cartons. Custom printed packaging and private-label labels can be arranged through our OEM and private label packing service. Each packed unit carries the product name, batch number, manufacturing date, expiry date, net weight, storage instructions and other required label details. Shelf life is 12 to 24 months from manufacture in unopened packs stored as recommended. The exact shelf life is confirmed for the agreed packaging and destination. Keep the powder tightly closed in a cool, dry, clean area away from direct sunlight, heat, moisture and strong odours. Reseal opened packs quickly and use clean, dry scoops when handling.

Wholesale MOQ, Lead Time and Samples

What is the minimum order quantity for wholesale beetroot powder? The MOQ is 5 Kg. This lets you start with a trial order before moving to regular bulk volumes. Private-label and printed packaging orders are reviewed separately, and we confirm the details once we know your pack size, label design and specification. What is the lead time? Lead time depends on raw-material availability, the current production schedule, order volume, packaging and shipping documentation. We confirm a realistic dispatch date with every quotation. Custom or private-label orders usually need extra time for artwork and packaging approval. How do I request a sample or quote? Samples are available on request. Send us your quantity, application, mesh size, packaging preference, destination country, target specification and whether you need private-label packing. Tradenest Naturals will review the request, confirm feasibility, share the product specification sheet and prepare a commercial quotation. Clear technical details at the start help avoid delays and make sure the material suits your use.

Why Source from Tradenest Naturals?

Tradenest Naturals, part of Tradenest International, is a manufacturer, wholesale supplier, exporter and private-label partner for dried ingredients based in Surat, India. Our work covers drying, milling, sieving, blending, custom formulation, bulk packing and OEM support. We focus on clear specifications, straightforward communication and practical solutions for each buyer. Whether you are looking for a beetroot powder supplier in India, a beetroot powder exporter in India, a beetroot powder wholesale partner or a regular source of beetroot powder for repeat shipments, we review every requirement individually. Contact Tradenest Naturals to discuss your needs and set up a supply programme that fits your market.
